card.name: Negation words after is/are/have
card.fires_on: Negating words such as not, no one, never right after a verb or subject, where the sentence is about to state what is absent, unknown or not recommended.

modes.label: not after a verb
modes.description: The word not follows is, are, have or experts, introducing a disclaimer or a statement that something is not established or not recommended.
modes.example: Use of alcohol while taking EMSAM is<< not>> recommended, even though EMSAM has not

modes.label: other negators
modes.description: Words like one, never, or is in a negative-leaning sentence (no one, never mind, none of this is).
modes.example: since no<< one>> really knows how life can manifest itself.

card.writes: It suppresses strong praise words like groundbreaking and amazing and promotes mild qualifiers like somewhat and relatively.
card.plain: It marks a spot where a sentence turns negative or hedged, so the next word is not likely to be glowing.
